test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 13 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7efedac6dbe7a86285a3fb91b9c529cecc74dd435dd0069f2af2d619e7817937.png]
solution:
The pattern followed here is:

1) Given triangle shifted downward in the second figure, then upward in the third figure, then again shifted downward in the fourth figure, and finally again shifted upward in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/eb570b0d6d7a0bb56ad1310df15ba3e766c74e8901c0de83f2d8cb87ff54d15b.png] 

2) Given circle is blank in the first figure, then the circle is dark in the second figure, then blank in the third figure, then again the circle is dark in the fourth figure, and again blank in the last figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cbf961f34d031303bbd3239fcc0c17525be5ef847b20439da7559bdc859a3b02.png] 

3) Given left upper side arrow is rotated 90º clockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a53e3f6d7e108c0f2c0da9b9098e1a1a0e5a2e6babb4b7f83119cc36b6967595.png] 

4) Given right upper side arrow is rotated in a 90º anti-clockwise direction in every next figure.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e748427397fb4323892f207cefd2b707cbb0d369e805bc4dcdc4039770d85db.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
